# Coupling to snapy and paddle {#sec-ch14}

This chapter describes what a dynamical core calls in kintera and which conventions both sides must share. The
hydrodynamic code snapy uses kintera as its equation of state and for saturation adjustment inside each stage.
Its example drivers and the Python driver paddle call the kinetics of @sec-ch06 once per step, after the
dynamics. kintera has no test of its own for these call sites; everything here rests on reading the calling code
at the pins of `tools/package-pins.json`, and no coupled run was made for this chapter.

The dependency map of the schemes is not provided: the figure module is not written yet.

| scheme | YAML key or option | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| @sec-ch14-thermo | the thermodynamics card | always | exact | none in kintera |
| @sec-ch14-saturation | the thermodynamics card | always | n/a | none in kintera |
| @sec-ch14-kinetics | `reactions` | driver | first | none in kintera |
